name: Marcus Thorne
psychographics: Skeptical of 'passive income' hype; values work-life balance and reliable health benefits more than maximizing every dollar
current_solutions: Uses QuickBooks Self-Employed for taxes, Loom for client walkthroughs, and a local credit union checking account
frustration: At 9:30 AM last Thursday, tried to log into the client portal for a new audit gig using the single sign-on link sent via email, but the token had expired exactly 12 hours after sending, forcing a password reset that locked him out of the portal for the morning session
decision_style: Reads the fine print on contracts; refuses auto-renewals unless the service adds clear value after the first year
voice: Formal, measured pace. Uses precise professional language ('whereas', 'hereinafter') but drops into casual 'you know' when explaining personal preferences
